Core42, a leader in AI-powered cloud and digital infrastructure, is driving transformative technology solutions globally. Leveraging advanced resources and partnerships, Core42 empowers clients to harness sovereign AI infrastructure, especially in sectors with stringent regulatory needs. With a mission to redefine digital transformation, we combine sovereign capabilities with scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure, positioning Core42 at the forefront of AI innovation in the Middle East and beyond.
Engineer – IP/MPLS participates in design and do implementation of Core42 DC Interconnect (DCI) infrastructure ensuring solution reliability and performance.
Engineer – IP/MPLS optimizes traffic patterns and deployment processes, controls efficient utilization of hardware resources.
q: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics/Telecom Engineering.
3-5 years experience in IP network implementation and operations.
Experience in cloud industry and Service Provider environment is highly desirable.
Deep knowledge of L2/L3 connectivity concepts: Ethernet, IPv4, IPv6.
Deep knowledge and hands on experience with the following technologies: OSPF, ISIS, MPLS, LDP, RSVP, BGP, MP-BGP, GRE, MACsec, QoS etc.
Deep knowledge and hands on experience of LDP and BGP based Layer 2 VPNs, Layer 3 VPNs, Inter VPN Route Leaking, Policy based Routing, EVPN Layer 2/Layer 3 VPNs and MPLS Traffic Engineering.
Experience with Internet Peering and Inter AS Peering.
Deep understanding of the following protocols: TCP, UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, IPSec, DNS.
Understanding of IP Multicast concepts and solutions (PIM, IGMP, MSR).
Experience in configuring and using different network management and monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Greylog etc.
Knowledge of Network Management Systems concepts and protocols such as NETCONF YANG, OpenFlow, SNMP, JMS, REST is a plus.
Hands on scripting experience using Python is a highly desirable.
Experience experience in Linux-based environments [CentOS/RHEL is desirable].
Team player, self-motivated, willing to learn, result oriented, willing to share knowledge.
GCC Driving license is highly desirable.
